table.retrieve:
select	
	Status=1,
	V.documentcode, 
	type = '*' + V.documenttype + '-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(6), V.documentcode))), 
	date = V.date, 
	debit = V.Debit, 
	credit= V.Credit,
	remark = V.Remarks,
	refno1 = '',
	refno2 =  '',
	refno3 =  '',
	refno4 = '',
	cashreceived='N',
	c.name,
	cash = case ISNULL(v.AlternateAccCode, -1) when -1 then 'N' else 'Y' end,
	c.aliasname,
	address=c.address1,
	address2=c.address2,
	phone=c.phone,
	fax=c.fax,
	city=c.city,
	c.areacode,
	c.area,
	V.CheckNo,
	V.VRow,
	V.vouchercode,
	PendingCheque=0,
	UserName = (SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode = V.UserCode)
FROM
	(SELECT * FROM DBO.Fn_GetUnposted_AccTrans()) AS V,
	(SELECT	a.aliasname, a.acccode, a.name, ct.address1,ct.address2,ct.city,ct.phone,ct.fax, ct.areacode, area=ar.name
	FROM	accounts a, customer ct, area ar
	WHERE	
			a.acccode = ct.custcode and 
			ar.areacode=ct.areacode) C
WHERE
	(V.AccCode = C.AccCode OR V.AlternateAccCode = C.AccCode ) AND
	V.date BETWEEN :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate
